findings.current: So get the hell out of my way. Unless you want to keep wearing that shiny armor.
findings.defect: The condition is reversed: Hong Jin threatens their positions if they do not move.
findings.rationale: The source makes continued service in uniform conditional on obeying him.
findings.replacement: So get the hell out of my way, if you want to keep wearing that shiny armor.
findings.source: 그러니 썩 꺼져. 앞으로도 그 번쩍이는 갑옷을 걸치고 싶다면.

findings.current: Two hours had passed since his young lord left to meet the Emperor.
findings.defect: Two shichen are approximately four hours, not two.
findings.rationale: The draft halves the elapsed time that drives Hong Jin’s anxiety.
findings.replacement: Around four hours had passed since his young lord left to meet the Emperor.
findings.source: 어린 주군이 황제를 알현하기 위해 떠난 지 어언 두 시진.

findings.current: Just as Hong Jin clenched his teeth without realizing it—
findings.defect: He bites his lip, not clenches his teeth.
findings.rationale: The source specifies a different physical action.
findings.replacement: Just as Hong Jin bit down hard on his lip without realizing it—
findings.source: 홍진이 자신도 모르게 입술을 질끈 깨문 그때였다.

findings.current: Well, it definitely wasn’t a dragon, since it couldn’t fly through the sky.
findings.defect: The draft claims the creature was unable to fly; Hyuk says only that it did not fly.
findings.rationale: Not observing flight does not establish an inability to fly.
findings.replacement: Well, it didn’t fly through the sky, so it definitely wasn’t a dragon—it was an imugi.
findings.source: 뭐 그래도 하늘을 날아다니지는 않았으니 용이 아니라 이무기였던 건 확실합니다.

findings.current: Oh, and he was a Supreme Peak master who looked about a hundred years old.
findings.defect: The draft invents a numerical apparent age; the source says he looked much older than his age.
findings.rationale: 겉늙었음 describes premature aging, not an appearance of being a hundred.
findings.replacement: Oh, and he was a Supreme Peak master who looked way older than he was.

findings.defect: Hong Jin says a formal word for pregnancy, not that the child is already an heir.
findings.rationale: This preserves his more formal register against Taekyung’s blunt “Pregnant” without adding a claim about succession.

findings.current: I paid a thousand nyang for that information
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated payment from a thousand in gold to a thousand nyang.
findings.rationale: 천금 specifies gold; nyang is not stated here.
findings.replacement: I paid a thousand gold pieces for that information

findings.current: would you be willing to spend another thousand nyang?
findings.defect: Hyuk refers back to the same payment in gold, not nyang.
findings.rationale: His proposed deal repeats the source’s 천금 amount.
findings.replacement: would you be willing to spend another thousand gold pieces?
findings.source: 혹시 천금 한 번 더 쓰실 용의 있으십니까?

summary: Several scene facts change in the draft, including a reversed threat, elapsed time, and physical actions. The ending also adds certainty to Hong Jin’s formal wording.
